scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The global phase classification is confined to the continuum two-strategy ODE for b=3c/2, gamma>1 and 0<alpha*c<2. It is not a result about finite stochastic populations, universal payoff asymmetry, or exact microscopic weak-selection validity. title: Sharp tristability threshold in symmetric Snowdrift complex contagion
